criteria.statement: Adapter-kernel tests prove deterministic normalization, bounded context, runtime-profile/policy consultation, and local/MCP coverage.
Wire-contract tests prove fail-closed trusted-state failures and narrowly conclusive outside-authority or explicit-policy allow outcomes.
Wire-contract tests and documentation inspection prove honest pre/post semantics, coverage reporting, and the static-fixture/runtime-smoke distinction.
Structural adapter tests prove phase agents are absent and rules/skills/generic agents do not own lifecycle authority.
Full compatibility verification passes and structural tests prove excluded later-stage components were not introduced.
